description: This file contains implementation of a Grain Service and its client for Orleans, including classes such as TestGrainService, TestGrainServiceClient, configuration options, and extension methods to register the service within a silo builder.

classes.name: TestGrainServiceClient
classes.description: A client for interacting with the TestGrainService, providing methods to access various service functionalities.

classes.name: TestGrainService
classes.description: The implementation of a Grain Service in Orleans that provides functionalities such as greeting, status checks, and configuration retrieval.

classes.name: TestGrainServicesSiloBuilderExtensions
classes.description: Extension methods for ISiloBuilder to register TestGrainService and related services.

classes.name: TestGrainServiceOptions
classes.description: Configuration options class holding properties for TestGrainService.

methods.name: GetHelloWorldUsingCustomService
methods.description: Returns a greeting string from the Grain Service.

methods.name: HasStarted
methods.description: Indicates whether the service has started.

methods.name: HasStartedInBackground
methods.description: Indicates whether the background start process has completed.

methods.name: HasInit
methods.description: Indicates whether the service has been initialized.

methods.name: EchoViaExtension
methods.description: Uses an extension method to echo a string.
